searched: Searched arXiv (MiniMax-01 2501.08313, MiniMax-M1 2506.13585), the MiniMax-AI GitHub repositories MiniMax-01, MiniMax-M1 and MiniMax-M2 (cloned history in a scratch directory; LICENSE histories read), the MiniMaxAI Hugging Face account (model listing; MiniMax-M3 commits, card and licence), MiniMax’s news pages on minimax.io and minimax.cn (index pages are JavaScript shells; M2 news and M3 post retrieved directly; guessed URLs for M1 and MiniMax-01 news returned 404), the HKEXnews prospectus of 31 December 2025 (Pre-IPO investor, milestone and content-safety sections), and a web search for a MiniMax frontier safety framework. No MiniMax-published frontier safety framework was located; third-party trackers seen only in search results (not evidence) listed MiniMax as not having published one at an undated time. The Seoul commitments listing is the existing record cm-seoul-minimax. Left out: cornerstone investors (agreements conditional on the offering), the 2025-02-20 LICENSE-MODEL/LICENSE-CODE texts, MiniMax-M2.1/M2.5/M2.7/M3.1-Flash, Hailuo and speech models, MiniMax-M2 and M3 technical reports (not located on arXiv), round-level amounts and valuations. Web.archive.org was not tried (refuses connections here). Coordinator: two drafted authorship records linking a listed author “Junjie Yan” to Yan Junjie were removed before merging, because the identification rests on the name alone and the same name appears in Moonshot AI author lists.
